messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none. Duplicates must refer to exactly the same real-world thing: different drugs, brand names, ingredients, formulations, doses, or a general category versus one of its members are NOT duplicates.

item: "tell your doctor if you have ever had recently received radiation therapy with iodine"
set: ["tell your doctor if you have ever had recently received radiation therapy with iodine", "tell your doctor if you have ever had thyroiditis", "tell your doctor if you have ever had anemia", "tell your doctor if you have ever had diabetes", "tell your doctor if you have ever had thyroid nodule", "tell your doctor if you have ever had heart problems", "tell your doctor if you have ever had weak bones", "tell your doctor if you have ever had liver or kidney disease", "tell your doctor if you have ever had problems with your pituitary or adrenal gland", "tell doctor if ever had kidney disease", "tell your doctor if you have ever had allergy to any food or drugs", "tell your doctor if you have ever had blood clot or blood clotting disorder", "tell doctor if have or have ever had kidney or pancreas disease", "tell your doctor if you have had problems with drug or alcohol abuse", "tell your doctor if you have phenylketonuria", "tell your doctor if you have diabetes"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
